name: 附录C 方岩旅店情况统计（仅限于新中国成立之前）
name_en: Appendix C: Statistics of Fangyan Inns (Before 1949)
highlights: 最早旅店程隆兴创建于清道光末年（1821-1850年）
程振兴创建于清光绪六年（1880年），1945年分家为老振兴（51间）和新振兴（48间）
程仁昌创建于清光绪八年（1882年），1935年分拍为老仁昌（22间）和新仁昌（22间）
义丰雅记创建于清咸丰年间（1851-1861年），10间，两层高三合院
旅店建筑类型包括四合院、三合院、沿街两层高建筑、中西合璧式洋楼等
content_zh:
方岩旅店情况统计（仅限于新中国成立之前），按创建时间排列：

程隆兴：创建人程岳标，后传程昭卿、程昭亨，清道光末年（1821-1850年）创建，两层高合院建筑（已坍塌），位于上坑口北侧，老街西侧。

马大和：创建人程茂发的曾祖父，姓马，来自东阳，清咸丰年间（1851-1861年）创建，合院建筑（已烧毁），位于老街南端转弯处，1925年之前被烧毁。

程义丰：创建人程乐镛（1832-1866年），后传三子程昭明，清咸丰年间（1851-1861年）创建，10间，两层高三合院，位于蜈蚣山西麓，老街西侧。

高永兴：清咸丰年间（1851-1861年）创建，仅在《永康县志》被提到，《方岩指南》中未提及，在老街上的位置不详。

新隆兴：创建人程昭相、程昭业（程岳标长子和三子），清光绪初年（1875-1882年）创建，14间，三层高合院建筑（近年烧毁），位于下胡坑坑口，老街西侧。

程振兴：创建人程昭夫（1857-1939年，程乐涞三子），清光绪六年（1880年）创建，两层高四合院两幢（1880、1909年），祠堂一座（1924年），两层高洋楼（1924-1942年之间），三层高洋楼（1942年），位于下胡坑坑口以北，老街两侧。

程仁昌：创建人程昭业（程岳标三子），清光绪八年（1882年）创建，三层高三合院，三层高小三合院（1887年），沿街两层高建筑（1920年），四层高洋楼（20世纪30年代初），位于狮子山西麓，老街中段西侧。

程义丰雅记：创建人程昭梭（程乐镛二子），两层高三合院，位于蜈蚣山西麓，老街西侧。

程成昌：创建人程昭丰（1855-1928年，程乐涞二子），民国初年（1925年以前）创建，15间，两层高四合院，位于下胡坑坑口，老街东侧。

程隆昌：创建人程昭贡（程乐涞六子），民国初年（1925年以前）创建，10间，两层高四合院，位于橙麓村，老街西侧。

程洪昌：创建人程宣成，民国初年（1925年以前）创建，10间，两层高四合院，位于橙麓村，老街西侧。

程乾昌：创建人程德喜，民国初年（1925年以前）创建，4间，两层高四合院，位于橙麓村，老街西侧。

程宝昌：创建人程扬苟，民国初年（1925年以前）创建，5间，两层高三合院，位于松门桥以南，老街西侧。

程大昌：创建人程金方，民国初年（1925年以前）创建，10间，三层高四合院，位于三问头，老街西侧。

程顺兴：民国初年（1925年以前）创建，沿街两层高建筑，位于三问头，老街西侧。

程永成潮记：创建人程烂章，民国初年（1925年以前）创建，10间，沿街两层高建筑，位于上坑口以南，老街西侧。

程美义：创建人烂头恕，民国初年（1925年以前）创建，6间，沿街两层高异型合院建筑，位于上坑口以南，老街东侧。

程同昌：民国初年（1925年以前）创建，沿街两层高建筑，位于橙麓村，老街北端西侧。

程沅沅：创建人程宣灿，民国年间（1925年以后）创建，6间，两层高三合院建筑沿街一侧，位于蜥蜴山西麓，老街西侧。

程义兴：创建人程方吐，1934年创建，3间，在老街上的位置不详。

老仁昌：创建人程宣洁，1935年由程仁昌分拍，22间，三层高四合院，位于狮子山西麓，老街中段西侧。

新仁昌：创建人程宣祜，1935年由程仁昌分拍，22间，四层洋楼，三层高小三合院，位于狮子山西麓，老街中段西侧。

程仁兴：创建人程方斗，1937年创建，4间，仅在《永康店名厂》中被提到，位置不详。

新顺兴：创建人程崇祯，1942年创建，5间，推测由程顺兴分拍，位于三问头，老街西侧。

程新民：创建人程宣科（程昭亨二子，程岳标孙），1944年创建，6间，两层高三合院，位于松门桥以西，老街西侧。

程安利：创建人程宣秋，1945年创建，6间，沿街两层高建筑，位于松门桥以西，老街东侧，程新民对面。

老振兴：创建人程宣吉，1945年由程振兴分拍，51间，两层高四合院一幢，程昭夫祠堂，位于下胡坑口以北，老街两侧。

新振兴：创建人程崇学，1945年由程振兴分拍，48间，两层高四合院一幢，两层高洋楼及三层高洋楼各一幢，位于下胡坑口以北，老街两侧。

程正兴：创建人程崇圭，1946年创建，5间，两层高小三合院，位于三问头，老街东侧。

程中兴：创建人程崇培（程昭相孙，程岳标曾孙），1946年创建，6间，沿街三层高建筑，位于下胡坑口以南，老街东侧。

名山：创建人程土藏，1946年创建，5间，沿街两层高建筑，位于狮子山西麓，老街东侧。

广慈寺：创建人程茂拔，22间。

天街旅店：千金楼（程章溪，民国初年，4间）、两面楼（程岩济，民国初年，4间）、三星店（民国初年，3间）、葫芦招牌（吕氏，民国初年，3间）、玉华楼（民国初年）、三门楼（民国初年）、天门店（程岩奎，1930年，4间）、狮子楼（程六妹，1930年，3间）、程泰康（程岩占，1934年，2间）、天官店（程瑞占，1942年，3间），均位于天街，程方峰祠堂附近。

注：旅店情况参考《永康县志》（1991）、《永康店名厂》（1995）、《方岩指南》（1925）、方岩明清街示意图（应业湘提供）及村民访谈综合得出。房间数目可能会随家庭成员人数的增减而稍有变化。表国分拍之意即开分店。
content_en:
Statistics of Fangyan inns (before 1949), arranged by founding date:

Cheng Longxing: Founded by Cheng Yuebiao, later passed to Cheng Zhaoqing and Cheng Zhaoheng, in the late Daoguang era (1821-1850). Two-story courtyard building (collapsed). North of Shangkengkou, west side of old street.

Ma Dahe: Founded by the great-grandfather of Cheng Maofa (surnamed Ma, from Dongyang), in the Xianfeng era (1851-1861). Courtyard building (burned down). At the southern turn of the old street, burned before 1925.

Cheng Yifeng: Founded by Cheng Leyong (1832-1866), later passed to his third son Cheng Zhaoming, in the Xianfeng era (1851-1861). 10 rooms, two-story three-sided courtyard. West foot of Centipede Mountain, west side of old street.

Gao Yongxing: Founded in the Xianfeng era (1851-1861). Only mentioned in Yongkang County Gazetteer, not in Fangyan Guide; location unknown.

Xin Longxing: Founded by Cheng Zhaoxiang and Cheng Zhaoye (eldest and third sons of Cheng Yuebiao), in the early Guangxu era (1875-1882). 14 rooms, three-story courtyard building (recently burned). At the mouth of Xiahu Pit, west side of old street.

Cheng Zhenxing: Founded by Cheng Zhaofu (1857-1939, third son of Cheng Lelai) in 1880. Two two-story courtyard houses (1880, 1909), one ancestral hall (1924), two-story Western-style building (1924-1942), three-story Western-style building (1942). North of Xiahu Pit mouth, both sides of old street.

Cheng Renchang: Founded by Cheng Zhaoye (third son of Cheng Yuebiao) in 1882. Three-story three-sided courtyard, three-story small three-sided courtyard (1887), two-story street-facing building (1920), four-story Western-style building (early 1930s). West foot of Lion Mountain, mid-west side of old street.

Cheng Yifeng Yaji: Founded by Cheng Zhaosuo (second son of Cheng Leyong). Two-story three-sided courtyard. West foot of Centipede Mountain, west side of old street.

Cheng Chengchang: Founded by Cheng Zhaofeng (1855-1928, second son of Cheng Lelai) in the early Republican period (before 1925). 15 rooms, two-story courtyard. At the mouth of Xiahu Pit, east side of old street.

Cheng Longchang: Founded by Cheng Zhaogong (sixth son of Cheng Lelai) in the early Republican period (before 1925). 10 rooms, two-story courtyard. Chenglu village, west side of old street.

Cheng Hongchang: Founded by Cheng Xuancheng in the early Republican period (before 1925). 10 rooms, two-story courtyard. Chenglu village, west side of old street.

Cheng Qianchang: Founded by Cheng Dexi in the early Republican period (before 1925). 4 rooms, two-story courtyard. Chenglu village, west side of old street.

Cheng Baochang: Founded by Cheng Yanggou in the early Republican period (before 1925). 5 rooms, two-story three-sided courtyard. South of Songmen Bridge, west side of old street.

Cheng Dachang: Founded by Cheng Jinfang in the early Republican period (before 1925). 10 rooms, three-story courtyard. Sanwentou, west side of old street.

Cheng Shunxing: Founded in the early Republican period (before 1925). Two-story street-facing building. Sanwentou, west side of old street.

Cheng Yongcheng Chaoji: Founded by Cheng Lanzhang in the early Republican period (before 1925). 10 rooms, two-story street-facing building. South of Shangkengkou, west side of old street.

Cheng Meiyi: Founded by Lantou Shu in the early Republican period (before 1925). 6 rooms, two-story irregular courtyard street-facing building. South of Shangkengkou, east side of old street.

Cheng Tongchang: Founded in the early Republican period (before 1925). Two-story street-facing building. Chenglu village, north end west side of old street.

Cheng Yuanyuan: Founded by Cheng Xuancan in the Republican period (after 1925). 6 rooms, two-story three-sided courtyard street-facing side. West foot of Lizard Mountain, west side of old street.

Cheng Yixing: Founded by Cheng Fangtu in 1934. 3 rooms, location unknown.

Lao Renchang: Founded by Cheng Xuanjie, split from Cheng Renchang in 1935. 22 rooms, three-story courtyard. West foot of Lion Mountain, mid-west side of old street.

Xin Renchang: Founded by Cheng Xuanhu, split from Cheng Renchang in 1935. 22 rooms, four-story Western-style building, three-story small three-sided courtyard. West foot of Lion Mountain, mid-west side of old street.

Cheng Renxing: Founded by Cheng Fangdou in 1937. 4 rooms, only mentioned in Yongkang Famous Shops and Factories, location unknown.

Xin Shunxing: Founded by Cheng Chongzhen in 1942. 5 rooms, presumably split from Cheng Shunxing. Sanwentou, west side of old street.

Cheng Xinmin: Founded by Cheng Xuanke (second son of Cheng Zhaoheng, grandson of Cheng Yuebiao) in 1944. 6 rooms, two-story three-sided courtyard. West of Songmen Bridge, west side of old street.

Cheng Anli: Founded by Cheng Xuanqiu in 1945. 6 rooms, two-story street-facing building. West of Songmen Bridge, east side of old street, opposite Cheng Xinmin.

Lao Zhenxing: Founded by Cheng Xuanji, split from Cheng Zhenxing in 1945. 51 rooms, one two-story courtyard, Cheng Zhaofu Ancestral Hall. North of Xiahu Pit mouth, both sides of old street.

Xin Zhenxing: Founded by Cheng Chongxue, split from Cheng Zhenxing in 1945. 48 rooms, one two-story courtyard, one two-story and one three-story Western-style building. North of Xiahu Pit mouth, both sides of old street.

Cheng Zhengxing: Founded by Cheng Chonggui in 1946. 5 rooms, two-story small three-sided courtyard. Sanwentou, east side of old street.

Cheng Zhongxing: Founded by Cheng Chongpei (grandson of Cheng Zhaoxiang, great-grandson of Cheng Yuebiao) in 1946. 6 rooms, three-story street-facing building. South of Xiahu Pit mouth, east side of old street.

Mingshan: Founded by Cheng Tuzang in 1946. 5 rooms, two-story street-facing building. West foot of Lion Mountain, east side of old street.

Guangci Temple: Founded by Cheng Maoba, 22 rooms.

Tianjie (Heavenly Street) inns: Qianjin Lou (Cheng Zhangxi, early Republican, 4 rooms), Liangmian Lou (Cheng Yanji, early Republican, 4 rooms), Sanxing Dian (early Republican, 3 rooms), Hulu Zhaopai (Lü family, early Republican, 3 rooms), Yuhua Lou (early Republican), Sanmen Lou (early Republican), Tianmen Dian (Cheng Yankui, 1930, 4 rooms), Shizi Lou (Cheng Liumei, 1930, 3 rooms), Cheng Taikang (Cheng Yanzhan, 1934, 2 rooms), Tianguan Dian (Cheng Ruizhan, 1942, 3 rooms). All on Tianjie, near Cheng Fangfeng Ancestral Hall.

Note: Compiled from Yongkang County Gazetteer (1991), Yongkang Famous Shops and Factories (1995), Fangyan Guide (1925), Fangyan Ming-Qing Street map (provided by Ying Yexiang), and villager interviews. Room counts may vary slightly with family size. Fenpai means opening a branch shop.
